open.description: Controls whether the sheet is open (`v-model:open`).

title.description: Optional centered title rendered in the drag-handle area.

dismissible.description: Allow outside-click, Escape, and swipe-down to close. Default `true`.

default.description: Sheet body, rendered in a scrollable region below the handle.

update:open.description: Fired when the open state changes via `v-model:open`.

after-leave.description: Fired after the close animation finishes.
